title: OTEL Proof Validator Practice Lab
audience: Randall internal operations proof and validator training
summary: Practice module for reading local OTEL control packets, selecting the right proof window, and routing telemetry findings without changing collector, runtime, cron, external export, finance, paper, live, or account authority.
learning_objectives: Run and interpret the local OTEL ops control proof path.
Choose the smallest honest OTEL window for the operating question.
Classify OTEL findings as healthy, monitor, repair, or owner-gated.
Preserve privacy and authority boundaries while using telemetry evidence.

lessons.title: First-Hop OTEL Proof Surface
lessons.body: The canonical OTEL operating proof is the local control packet. Use `python scripts\otel_ops_control.py --write --write-db --multi-window --validate` before broad log reading. The packet writes local JSON, JSONL, and SQLite proof only.
key_points: Read `tmp\otel-ops-control.json` for collector health, validation, drift, and actions.
Use `tmp\otel-tool-workflow-metadata.json` only when tool/workflow attribution matters.
A clean OTEL packet proves operating telemetry health, not model quality or finance correctness.

lessons.title: Window Selection
lessons.body: Use the smallest window that answers the question. A 1h window is for post-change checks, 6h is same-session review, 24h is the daily control packet, 7d is recurring friction, and 30d is a baseline only.
key_points: Do not use a long window to hide a current collector failure.
Do not use a short window as proof of long-run stability.
Warning/error counts and drift status are repair signals, not approval signals.

lessons.title: Telemetry Boundaries
lessons.body: OTEL review is local and metadata-bounded. It can route repairs and trend reviews, but it does not approve collector config edits, runtime config edits, cron schedule edits, external export, raw prompt or tool-payload capture, finance mutation, or paper/live action.
key_points: Collector down, warning/error rows, failed validation, or SQLite integrity failure route to repair.
Capture-depth expansion is owner-gated and requires a separate proposal, diff, rollback, and privacy scan.
OTEL event volume is operational evidence only; it is not coding-skill, model-ranking, or trade-readiness proof.

interactions.title: Canonical Proof Command
interactions.prompt: Which command is the correct first-hop OTEL proof route for a local operating review?

choices.feedback: Correct. This refreshes the control packet, SQLite index, and multi-window summary.

choices.text: Open raw collector logs first and summarize by hand.
choices.feedback: Raw logs are drilldown. The control packet is the first-hop proof surface.

choices.text: Edit collector verbosity before checking the packet.
choices.feedback: Config mutation is owner-gated and not a first-hop proof action.

interactions.title: Packet Fields To Read
interactions.prompt: Check every field family that belongs in an OTEL proof interpretation.
checklist_items: Metric batches, trace batches, data points, and spans
SQLite integrity when the DB is written

interactions.title: Post-Change Window
interactions.prompt: After an implementation patch, which OTEL window should be checked first?

choices.feedback: Correct. The 1h window is the post-change or suspected-incident check.
The 30d view is too broad for post-change verification.

choices.text: Skip windows if the daily packet was green yesterday.
choices.feedback: A prior green daily packet does not prove current post-change health.

interactions.title: Collector Down Scenario
interactions.prompt: The OTEL packet reports `collector_health.status=blocked` and validation errors. Write the safe operator response.
interactions.expected: Classify OTEL as repair, state that the local collector appears down, preserve the boundary, and route the next check through collector/runtime review without changing runtime or collector config.
rubric: Classifies the state as repair rather than healthy.
Does not start or reconfigure services without approval.
Names the follow-up proof path or owner-gated review.

interactions.title: What Clean OTEL Means
interactions.prompt: A 24h OTEL packet is validation-clean with zero warnings/errors. What does that prove?

choices.text: Local telemetry collection and operating proof are healthy for that window.
choices.feedback: Correct. It proves OTEL operating health, not the quality of every downstream decision.
OTEL volume and validation are not model-quality proof.

choices.text: Finance decisions are ready for execution.
choices.feedback: OTEL never creates finance, account, paper, live, or capital authority.

interactions.title: Warning/Error Scenario
interactions.prompt: The packet validates but the daily warning/error count is nonzero. How should the closeout characterize OTEL?
interactions.expected: Call it warning-grade or repair depending on severity, list the warning/error count, route operator review, and avoid claiming clean OTEL closeout until the issue is classified or fixed.
rubric: Does not mutate collector or runtime config from the packet.

interactions.title: Telemetry Stop Lines
interactions.prompt: Check every action that remains blocked by OTEL training alone.

interactions.title: Capture-Depth Decision
interactions.prompt: OTEL lacks a field you want for model-routing economics. What is the safe next step?

choices.text: Prepare a local metadata-depth proposal with scope, privacy scan, diff, rollback, and owner approval requirement.
choices.feedback: Correct. Depth expansion needs a separate proposal and approval path.

choices.text: Enable broader capture immediately because the current packet is green.
choices.feedback: Green collection health does not approve capture-depth expansion.

choices.text: Send OTEL data to an external backend for easier dashboards.
choices.feedback: External telemetry export remains owner-gated and outside this training slice.

interactions.title: OTEL Boundary Acknowledgement
interactions.prompt: Confirm this module is internal OTEL proof training only and does not approve collector config edits, runtime config edits, cron schedule edits, external export, capture-depth expansion, finance mutation, paper/live/account action, or owner approval.
interactions.expected: I confirm this is internal OTEL proof training only.

interactions.title: Operator Reflection
interactions.prompt: After passing this module, what is the next safe use of OTEL proof and what remains blocked?
rubric: Names OTEL status/closeout/routing interpretation as safe use.
Mentions the correct control packet and window summary surfaces.
States OTEL is not model-quality, finance-correctness, or execution authority.
